name: Running speed with varying incline, 6 weeks (running mode)
goal: Raise running speed and hill power: fartlek with grade changes, short steep sprints, a speed pyramid up to 12 km/h and incline tempo blocks, then a taper.
audience: Healthy runners who can already run 10 km/h for 30 minutes. Needs the console's handrail raised (running mode) and the staged running-speed validation (run-7 to run-12) done first; the CLI refuses speeds that are not validated. The treadmill has no downhill, so add outdoor running for descents.

sessions.off: Strength 30-40 min: squats, step-ups, lunges, calf raises, plank. Stop if anything hurts.

sessions.note: Fast RPE 7, climb RPE 7, float RPE 4.

sessions.off: Rest or an easy outdoor walk.
Strength 30-40 min: squats, step-ups, lunges, calf raises, plank. Stop if anything hurts.

sessions.note: Ten 30-second sprints; stop a rep early if the form goes.

sessions.off: Strength 30-40 min: squats, step-ups, lunges, calf raises, plank. Stop if anything hurts.

sessions.note: The 12 km/h block is the machine maximum; hold form, do not strain.

sessions.off: Strength 30-40 min: squats, step-ups, lunges, calf raises, plank. Stop if anything hurts.

sessions.note: Same effort on the flat and the climb.
Only as many sprints as feel crisp.

sessions.off: Your race or a time trial.

weeks.note: Cut the volume; keep a little speed.
